column1: # SLD-lint grandfather allowlist (ratchet — can only shrink).
# Format: <repo-relative-path><TAB><check-id>   (one grandfathered pair per row)
# Blank lines and lines beginning with `#` are ignored.
# Why this exists: DOC-38 §10 F5/F6 track the incremental retrofit of existing
# specs (frontmatter, header blocks, `{#SPEC-…~rev}` anchors) and §4.1/§9 the
# documented DOC-28 collision + DOC-34/DOC-37 catalog gaps. Those pre-existing
# specs are NOT failed by `sld-lint --strict`; each is grandfathered here for the
# specific check it currently violates. As F3/F5/F6 land, remove the matching row
# (the ratchet only shrinks). DEFAULT mode does not consult these — it already
# passes on the whole tree; the allowlist only relaxes `--strict`.
# spec-header  — spec predates the DOC-38 §4.2 bold-field header block (F6).
# spec-id-grammar — section anchors use pre-DOC-38 slug form (…-layers) or omit
#                   the ~rev suffix; retrofitting to SPEC-…~rev is F6.
# spec-catalog — assigned but uncataloged DOC-N (DOC-34/DOC-37; catalog-row is F3-adjacent).
